title: identity.member.reactivated.v1
description: An owner or admin reactivated a deactivated member (synthwerk#37). The Zitadel user grant is active again with the stored role. CloudEvents subject: the user sub. The orgid extension holds org_id. actor: user:<sub>. No email, no personal name.

user_sub.description: Subject id (token sub) of the member. Never an email.

role.description: Org role the member has again.
